moremax.us.title: Due Date
moremax.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Dark comedy, Comedy drama) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Internship
moremax.us.description: After old-school salesmen Billy and Nick find themselves downsized, Billy decides that, despite their complete lack of technological savvy, they should work for Google. The friends somehow manage to finagle internships at the Internet giant and promptly head out to Silicon Valley. Viewed with disdain by most of their fellow interns, Billy and Nick join forces with the rest of the misfit "nooglers" to make it through a series of competitive team challenges. (Comedy) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
moremax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Joker
moremax.us.description: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. (Crime drama) - 2019

moremax.us.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
moremax.us.description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him. (Musical, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2024

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
moremax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
moremax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
moremax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

moremax.us.title: Lord of the Flies
moremax.us.description: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first, they cooperate, but when they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph (James Aubrey) and the other by militaristic Jack (Tom Chapin) -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion. (Drama, Adventure, Thriller) - 1963

moremax.us.title: The Darkest Minds
moremax.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Enter Nowhere
moremax.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Rampage
moremax.us.description: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Shazam!
moremax.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2019

moremax.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
moremax.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Time Bandits
moremax.us.description: Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them. (Fantasy) - 1981

moremax.us.title: Hidden Figures
moremax.us.description: Three brilliant African American women at NASA, Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson, serve as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in history, the launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit, a stunning achievement that restored the nation's confidence, turned around the Space Race and galvanized the world. (Historical drama, Docudrama, Biography) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Robin Hood
moremax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Judge
moremax.us.description: Hank Palmer (Robert Downey Jr.), a brilliant but shady attorney, returns to his Indiana hometown after learning that his mother has passed away. His arrival triggers renewed tension between himself and his father, Judge Joseph Palmer (Robert Duvall), who makes no secret of his disapproval of Hank's morally ambiguous career. As the lawyer prepares to depart, his father is arrested for a hit-and-run death. Hank takes on his father's defense, despite the objections of the resentful old man. (Drama) - 2014

moremax.us.title: Trap
moremax.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

moremax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
moremax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

moremax.us.title: Arctic
moremax.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (Adventure, Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Epic
moremax.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Mojave
moremax.us.description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home. (Thriller) - 2015

moremax.us.title: Beirut
moremax.us.description: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working undercover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success. (Thriller, Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Aftermath
moremax.us.description: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter. (Thriller, Drama, Action) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Gimme Shelter
moremax.us.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco. (Documentary) - 1970

Chaque semaine, une chasse extraordinaire pour une espèce différente de gibier est présentée. Chaque épisode s'efforce d'éduquer, d'informer et de divertir à travers l'équilibre unique de l'expérience de chasse combinée aux interactions humaine et biologique avec les espèces chassées. BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E6 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 2 Investigating the caves, the Doctor is attacked by a dinosaur-like creature. Dr Quinn is hiding a secret that could endanger the lives of everyone.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E7 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 3 The creature from the caves, wounded and dangerous, is on the loose on Wenley Moor. Dr Quinn attempts to recover it and is unwilling to listen to the Doctor’s warnings.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E8 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 4 Fearful of a war breaking out between the Silurians and mankind, the Doctor attempts to make peace between the races. But there are those on both sides unwilling to listen.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E9 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 5 When the Silurian leader is killed, all hopes of peace are lost. The Silurian’s infect Major Baker with a virus deadly to humans and release him to spread the infection.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E10 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 6 As the Silurian plague quickly spreads, the Doctor desperately searches for a cure. But the Silurians are aware of the Doctor’s efforts and intend to stop him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E11 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 7 With the antidote to the plague found, the Silurians retaliate and take over the research centre. They now intend to destroy the Van Allen Belt, resulting in death for all mankind.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E12 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 1 Contact has been lost with Mars Probe 7. When contact is also lost with the recovery ship, UNIT is called in and the Doctor learns that someone is sending messages to the vessel.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E13 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 2 Recovery 7 has returned to Earth but the UNIT convoy transporting the capsule is ambushed. The Doctor is able to relocate the capsule, but is he too late?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E14 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 3 The recovery capsule is empty with the astronauts seemingly kidnapped. But Liz notices that the radiation count is high and the Doctor deduces that the occupants were not human.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E15 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 4 Liz has been captured by Reegan who is holding the three aliens captive. The Doctor suspects Quinlan’s part in the conspiracy, but Quinlan is killed before he can reveal the truth.

BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E16 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 5 The Doctor prepares to pilot the Recovery 7 ship into space, but Reegan sabotages the fuel supply which will send the Doctor into the sun.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E17 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 6 On board a vast spacecraft, the Doctor meets the alien captain who demands the return of the three ambassadors sent to Earth or he will destroy the world.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E18 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 7 General Carrington is behind the kidnapping of the ambassadors and intends to turn the world against the aliens by revealing their true identity to the world in a TV broadcast.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E19 Inferno: Episode 1 UNIT are at a project run by Professor Stahlman who intends to penetrate Earth’s crust. But the drilling has already released something deadly from beneath the Earth’s surface.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E20 Inferno: Episode 2 The green slime oozing from the drill head is transforming men into monsters. Stahlman refuses to listen to the warnings and resorts to sabotage so that his project may continue.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E21 Inferno: Episode 3 Transported to a parallel world, the Doctor discovers that England is under military rule and the drilling project is at a more advanced stage.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E22 Inferno: Episode 4 In the parallel world, the drilling project is about to penetrate the Earth’s crust. The Doctor, arrested as a spy, is unable to convince his captors of the danger that faces them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E23 Inferno: Episode 5 In the parallel world, Earth’s crust has been penetrated, releasing terrible forces from within the Earth. The Doctor must escape back to his world to prevent the same catastrophe.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E24 Inferno: Episode 6 As the Earth in the parallel world faces destruction, the Doctor is desperate to return to his world to warn them of the danger. But time is running out.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E25 Inferno: Episode 7 The Doctor has escaped the doomed, parallel Earth and has returned to his own world where he attempts to put a halt to the drilling project.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E1 Terror of the Autons: Episode 1 The Master, a renegade Time Lord and a rival of the Doctor’s, arrives on Earth and paves the way for an invasion by the insidious Nestene Consciousness.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E2 Terror of the Autons: Episode 2 The Doctor follows the Master’s trail to the circus. Meanwhile, the Master has used his hypnotic powers to take control of a plastics factory where he creates the deadly Autons.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E3 Terror of the Autons: Episode 3 The Doctor and the Brigadier trace the Master to the plastics factory but they are too late. The only clue to the Master’s plans is a single plastic daffodil.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E4 Terror of the Autons: Episode 4 The Doctor and UNIT race to prevent the Master from broadcasting the deadly activation signal and opening the channel for the Nestene’s arrival on Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E13 Survival: Part 2 The Doctor and a number of people from Perivale follow Ace to the Cheetah-People’s world, where the Master lies in wait. He cannot leave without the Doctor's assistance.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E14 Survival: Part 3 As the alien world dies around them, the Doctor and the Master fight like animals before escaping to Earth, where their war ends. And somewhere else, the tea is getting cold.

ABCMESydney.au.title: My Adventures With Superman
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E10 Hearts Of The Fathers It's Thanksgiving, and Clark, Lois, and Jimmy are heading to the Kent farm to celebrate - but the holiday turns into a fight for survival as Task Force X, family, and Kryptonite collide!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokémon Journeys
ABCMESydney.au.description: S23 E5 Mind-boggling Dynamax! Ash and Goh search the Wild Area for giant Pokemon, and a little friend wants to join them!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Do Not Watch This Show
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E5 Big Keith While gardening, Wizz accidentally sprays Keith with Boom Bloom, a spray that makes things grow before our eyes.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Shaun The Sheep: Brain Breaks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 Spot The Difference Time to test your memory! Enjoy some classic spot the difference fun as you compare two pictures featuring Shaun the Sheep, Bitzer and Timmy. Can you spot the changes before the timer runs out?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Alphablocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E27 Maze The Alphablocks manage to find their way out of a maze by learning to read signs with helpful words written on them, saying NO, GO, GO TO and GO IN.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Colourblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 Green Green arrives, bringing her natural colour to Colourland. Learn about the colour green with the Colourblocks.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E3 Two Two finds a pair of magic dancing shoes and shows One that everything is better with two, singing and counting things that belong in pairs. Learn all about the number 2 with Numberblock Two.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Wonderblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E24 Potted Plant Parade Toad needs another potted plant for the flower show after he drops the first one, and it needs eight flowers on it for the competition.

ABCMESydney.au.title: One, Two, Threebies!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Oddly Even Boxy is making an even number of toast slices. until Tri comes along and eats one!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E30 The Letter f Fun Fair! Power Paige and Mr. More compete to win a rare first edition Miss Mega comic book!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Little J And Big Cuz
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E3 Radio Show Big Cuz fears she's bitten off more than she can chew when she offers to organise the school's radio broadcast.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E13 How is it Made? Cereal In today's episode, Maddie is finding out where our food comes from. She visits a cereal factory to see how wheat biscuits are made.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Understanding Numbers
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E6 Reading and Naming Numerals Learn how to read and name numbers that are all around you. Learn to read both one- and two-digit numbers.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Wordsville
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E20 The Case Of The Swiped Scents Scientist Cosmo's smell machine and the words STENCH and AROMA have been swiped! Now, nobody can smell any scents!

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Brilliant World Of Tom Gates
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E19 Rock, Paper, Scissors Tom and his friends play Rock, Paper, Scissors at school but Marcus adds a new the rule. Liz draws around a paperclip, a pencil sharpener and a straw to create 3D doodles.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Art With Mati And Dada
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 Vincent Van Gogh Mati and Dada help Vincent recapture a little cloud that escaped from one of his paintings.

ABCMESydney.au.title: My Place
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E25 Before Time Bunda Bunda tries everything to get his older brothers' attention but all Bunda gets is his brothers' anger and contempt. They need to learn to stop teasing each other and become friends as well as brothers.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Hey You What If?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E4 You Woke Up as a Lizard Superhero? We've had Batman (and Batgirl), Antman, Spiderman, Ninja turtles and Black Panthers. Well stand aside, coz it's time to see what a hybrid human-lizard superhero could do!

ABCMESydney.au.title: BtN Newsbreak
ABCMESydney.au.description: E207 Episode 207 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E8 Touring Theatre And Secret Garden Flat A touring theatre performer comes up with an ingenious plan to keep the show on the road, by taking his home on the road. George and Will come to the end of their tour with a taste of Italy in Wales' Port Merion. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E10 An ex-M15 officer is convinced that Harry was involved in the assassination of Lady Diana and forces Ruth to investigate.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E5 The team investigate the murder of a former children's home resident. Meanwhile, Marlon sits his sergeant's exams, and Selwyn meets his daughter for the first time.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E16 Landmarks Stephen Fry looks at some landmarks. With Jo Brand, Colin Lane, David Mitchell and Alan Davies. (Final).

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Time Bandits
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Six fractious dwarfs steal a precious map that shows the locations of a series of time holes scattered across the universe, enabling them to travel back in time. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Stay
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: A thriller about a psychologist whose client makes bizarre predictions that--to the psychologist's mounting terror-- begin to come true. He must race against time to save everything he loves. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Turn Me On
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: In a world where the inconvenience of human emotion has been eradicated by a single daily vitamin, one young couple skips their dose and discovers love, joy, sex and the baggage that comes with it. (Comedy)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: The Snows of Kilimanjaro
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Writer Harry Street reflects on his life as he lies dying from an infection while on safari in the shadow of Mount Kilamanjaro. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Mary Shelley
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: She will forever be remembered as the writer who gave the world Frankenstein. But the real life story of Mary Shelley - and the creation of her immortal monster - is as fantastical as her prose. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Living
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: This is the story of an ordinary man, reduced by years of oppressive office routine to a shadow existence, who at the eleventh hour makes a supreme effort to turn his dull life into something wonderful. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Braveheart
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Romance, intrigue, heroism and the desperate battle for nothing less than the freedom of Scotland. The story of William Wallace whose passion and courage united the Scottish people in the struggle. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Resistance
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Before becoming the world-famous mime Marcel Marceau, aspiring Jewish actor Marcel Mangel (Jesse Eisenberg) joins the French Resistance to save thousands of orphaned children from the Nazis. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Recon
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: As WWII ends, four American soldiers are sent on a reconnaissance mission led by a partisan with indeterminate loyalties. Hunted by a mysterious sniper, they must fight to make it out alive. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Spear
SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.description: Seeing the problems faced by Aboriginal men in remote and urban communities, a young Aboriginal man sets off on a journey of initiation to understand what it means to be a man in a modern-day world. (Drama)

SBSWorldMoviesSydney.au.title: Dancing At Lughnasa

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef - Old Favourites
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Maggie and Simon bring back some Old Favourites and, of course, reveal secrets that take your cooking to another level. Inspired by tradition and a gift of a pot from his Mum. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Laura is in the beautiful Adelaide Hills, creating a winter warmer: Mushroom Pies. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes - Pesto Pasta & Chicken Cutlet
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rachael brings the flavour with her Lemon Lover's Chicken Cutlets and Pesto Pasta. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Wendy joins Laura as they make a Swedish potato pudding; Tobie makes tiramisu; Catherine cooks spring onion in the form of a chip; Simone prepares delicious rice paper rolls. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home - Beans
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: The beautiful British summer-time sees Jamie getting a thorough soaking as he picks the beans in his garden. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: There are some great recipes shared on today's episode including; Roast Duck, Peanut & Glass Noodle Salad, Cucumber and Mint Gazpacho with Sour Cream, and Mango and Passionfruit Cheesecakes. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - The Great Australian Pub Meal
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Chef Jacqui Challinor and actor Dave Lawson join Adam to make great Australian pub meals at home. And they won't even charge you extra for sauce. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy - Soup's On!
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Mary. Loves. Soup. Join the soup obsession with recipes that vary from cozy to chill, smooth or chunky, plus an ample dose of cheese, duh. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Salt Your Pasta Water!
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: It's pasta time again, so don't forget to salt the pasta water, and sauce your pasta the way the Italians do! Lidia prepares a pasta primavera, then a cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices - The Ancient Cheese Of Portugal
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Until recently, Portugal's traditional ewe's milk cheeses were rarely found outside the country. Will travels to the rugged mountains of the north to find out more about the king of Portuguese cheese. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Legends Of The Fork - Bringing The Heat
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: We're turning up the heat! Buddy visits two iconic hotspots who are famous for their intensely spicy dishes. First, he heads to Jitlada in Los Angeles, California to see if he can withstand the heat. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera - Monte Carlo Noel
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Luana takes us behind the scenes of the Principality's most iconic landmarks, including Casino Square, the Cafe de Paris, and the kitchens of the Hotel Hermitage Monte-Carlo. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery - Nordjylland, Denmark
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen - Lemon Grass And Soya Turtle, Shellfish Stir-Fry Noodle, Susami
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Bundy runs his own Cultural Tours business out of Chile Creek near the communities of Djarindjin and Lombadina. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef - Winter Comfort Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: It's time to shake off the winter blues with a serve of piping hot comfort food. This mid-winter episode dishes up some warming, homely treats - and reveals why Simon still bears the mental scars. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Laura visits the wonderful Adelaide Central Markets and cooks up an Asian-inspired Kingfish Sashimi with Nahm Jim. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes - Bacon Jack Burger
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rachael shares her secrets for the ultimate Bacon Jack Burger, from scoring the meat for perfect portions to packing equal amounts of crispy bacon into every bite. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: This episode celebrates saffron, one of the world's most prized ingredients. Luca begins with a golden, fragrant risotto, follows with a refined pasta dish that lets saffron truly shine. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Holidays - Vegetarian Feast
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rachael shows how to prepare a show-stopping, meat-free holiday meal that everyone will love! First, she makes a rich and flavourful pumpkin soup using Italian pumpkins. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Things get dicey after Laura is inspired by in-season passionfruit at the market and decides to make a passionfruit sponge cake. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home - Onions
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Jamie pulls up some of his first onions of the year and makes a crisp and fresh cheese and onion salad. The red onions he uses in an onion and potato al forno with tender roast pork. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Hong Kong Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Justine shows you around Macao on today's episode and shows off her Chicken and Asian Mushroom Fricassee Stew with a view! (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - The Italian Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Chef Giovanni Pilu and author Julia Busuttil Nishimura join Adam for a night of Easy Entertaining at The Italian Table. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella's Cook, Eat, Repeat Christmas - Nigella's Cook, Eat, Repeat Christmas Special
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: The Christmas tree is up, the tea lights are sparkling, wood burns in the fire pit and it's the culinary hi-light of the festive season and this year Nigella is indulging in kitchen table tourism. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Berry's Ultimate Christmas
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Much loved British home cook Mary Berry is joined by some famous friends for her ultimate Christmas feast, packed with tips to plan and get ahead for the big day. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie's Comfort Food - The Ultimate Cheese Toastie
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Jamie is joined by his friend Gennaro to make a delicious bolognese ravioli. Plus, Jamie puts together the ultimate cheese toast, and cooks a chicken tikka masala. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - The Italian Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Chef Giovanni Pilu and author Julia Busuttil Nishimura join Adam for a night of Easy Entertaining at The Italian Table. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Mackerel

krqedt2.us.title: Below Deck
krqedt2.us.description: This reality series profiles a group of young people who work aboard yachts that measure well over 100 feet long. The crew members, known as yachties, live aboard the luxurious, privately owned vessels while making sure that their demanding clients' ever-changing needs are met. The yachties share a passion for a job that allows them to visit some of the world's most beautiful places. Each episode features a different group of passengers -- ranging from millionaires to hard-partying friends -- as they head out for a marine adventure. The crews live by the "work hard, play harder" motto that gives them access to exotic perks few people get to experience. (Reality, Entertainment, Travel, Romance) - 2013-07-01

The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

ktxa.us.description: With all of the various animal species roaming around the planet there's a lot to know about animals, which means no one knows everything about them. Thankfully "Zoo Clues" fills in some of the blanks. Each half-hour episode investigates at least a dozen questions about animals to provide viewers with answers. With help from his sister and a troubled young islander, Pádraic sets out to repair the damaged relationship by any means necessary. However, as Colm's resolve only strengthens, he soon delivers an ultimatum that leads to shocking consequences. (Dark comedy) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Dirty Mary, Crazy Larry
fxm.us.description: Down on their luck and out of cash, high-speed racer Larry (Peter Fonda) and his repairman (Adam Roarke) plan to hold up a supermarket that's fat with a fresh payroll. Larry hopes to score enough to buy his ideal car, and then join the professional league. At the last minute, their heist is complicated by the addition of Larry's on-off girlfriend (Susan George), who's all jazzed up for the burglary. Larry's racing skills will be pushed to the limit in this chase-packed action thriller. (Action) - 1974

fxm.us.title: Surf Party
fxm.us.description: An Arizona gal (Patricia Morrow) and her friends enjoy sun, sand and romance when they drive out to California for a surfing vacation. (Musical comedy, Romance) - 1964

fxm.us.title: How to Marry a Millionaire
fxm.us.description: Schatze Page, Loco Dempsey and Pola Debevoise (Lauren Bacall, Betty Grable, Marilyn Monroe) are three women on a mission: They all want to marry a millionaire. To accomplish this task, they move into a fancy New York City apartment and begin courting the city's elite. They have no problem meeting rich men, but unfortunately most of them turn out to be creeps or cons. Eventually they must decide: Is a life of luxury more important to them than finding true love? (Comedy) - 1953

fxm.us.title: The Seven Year Itch
fxm.us.description: In the midst of a summer heat wave, New Yorker Richard Sherman (Tom Ewell) ships his wife, Helen (Evelyn Keyes), and their son off to Maine for vacation. Left alone to work back in Manhattan, Richard encounters a gorgeous blonde model (Marilyn Monroe) who has moved into the apartment upstairs, and becomes immediately infatuated. While pondering infidelity, Richard dreams of his beautiful new neighbor -- but will his fantasies about her become a reality? (Comedy) - 1955

fxm.us.title: Let's Make Love
fxm.us.description: One of the wealthiest men in the world, Jean-Marc Clement (Yves Montand) is rich in money, but lacking in love. While seeking someone who adores him for his personality rather than his fortune, Clement learns that he is the subject of a satirical theater production. Unrecognized as he visits the play's set, Clement is offered the part as himself by the show's unwitting producers, and he takes the gig to be close to the gorgeous yet down-to-earth actress Amanda Dell (Marilyn Monroe). (Musical comedy) - 1960

fxm.us.title: Bedazzled
fxm.us.description: Stanley Moon (Dudley Moore) is a bumbling short-order cook, infatuated with Margaret (Eleanor Bron), the statuesque waitress he works with at Wimpy Burger in London. On the verge of suicide, he meets George Spiggott (Peter Cook), the devil, who, in return for his soul, grants him seven wishes to woo the challenging Margaret. Despite the wishes and the advice of the Seven Deadly Sins, including Lilian Lust (Raquel Welch), Stanley can't seem to win his love and shake the meddling Spiggott. (Comedy) - 1967

fxm.us.title: Young Frankenstein
fxm.us.description: Respected medical lecturer Dr. Frederick Frankenstein (Gene Wilder) learns that he has inherited his infamous grandfather's estate in Transylvania. Arriving at the castle, Dr. Frankenstein soon begins to recreate his grandfather's experiments with the help of servants Igor (Marty Feldman), Inga (Teri Garr) and the fearsome Frau Blücher (Cloris Leachman). After he creates his own monster (Peter Boyle), new complications ensue with the arrival of the doctor's fiancée, Elizabeth (Madeline Kahn). (Comedy) - 1974

fxm.us.title: The Duke
fxm.us.description: In 1961, a 60-year-old taxi driver steals Goya's portrait of the Duke of Wellington from the National Gallery in London. He sends ransom notes saying that he will return the painting if the government invests more in care for the elderly. (Comedy drama) - 2020

fxm.us.title: See How They Run
fxm.us.description: In the 1950s London, plans for a movie version of a smash-hit play come to an abrupt halt after a pivotal member of the crew is murdered. When a world-weary inspector and an eager rookie constable take on the case, they find themselves thrown into a puzzling whodunit within the glamorously sordid world of underground theater, investigating the mysterious homicide at their own peril. (Mystery, Comedy) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Death on the Nile
fxm.us.description: Belgian sleuth Hercule Poirot's Egyptian vacation aboard a glamorous river steamer turns into a terrifying search for a murderer when a picture-perfect couple's idyllic honeymoon is tragically cut short. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Two for the Road
fxm.us.description: Architect Mark Wallace and his wife, Joanna, travel to France to meet with an affluent client. While there, they reflect on their first decade of marriage -- memories of when they first met, of courtship and of road trips through the French countryside. As flirtation and playful quarreling turn to boredom with the banality of married life, the Wallaces struggle to rekindle their passion, while mutual infidelity threatens to tear them apart. (Romantic comedy) - 1967

fxm.us.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
fxm.us.description: Lorelei Lee (Marilyn Monroe) is a beautiful showgirl engaged to be married to the wealthy Gus Esmond (Tommy Noonan), much to the disapproval of Gus' rich father, Esmond Sr., who thinks that Lorelei is just after his money. When Lorelei goes on a cruise accompanied only by her best friend, Dorothy Shaw (Jane Russell), Esmond Sr. hires Ernie Malone (Elliott Reid), a private detective, to follow her and report any questionable behavior that would disqualify her from the marriage. (Musical comedy) - 1953

fxm.us.title: How to Be Very, Very Popular
fxm.us.description: A showgirl from the San Francisco cabaret is murdered, and the only witnesses are fellow showgirls Stormy Tornado (Betty Grable) and Curly Flagg (Sheree North). Afraid of both the murderers and the cops, the two go on the run, eventually deciding to pose as male students at Bristol College. Neither girl can avoid the spotlight for too long, though, and their constant desire to stand out among the crowd eventually gets the better of them, resulting in their cover being blown. (Comedy) - 1955

fxm.us.title: 9 to 5
fxm.us.description: Office satire about three female secretaries who decide to get revenge on their tyrannical, sexist boss by abducting him and running the business themselves. The trio, one of whom has been passed over for promotion because she is a woman, spend a night together having drug-induced fantasies of killing the slave-driving chauvinist. One of them panics the following day when she suspects she really has poisoned the tyrant. (Comedy) - 1980

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

However, the sophisticated couple's arrival stirs resentment and suspicion among the locals, especially from Charlie (Alexander Skarsgård), Amy's former boyfriend. Tension continues to build, leading to an extremely violent confrontation. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2011-09-16

She sets out to track down the real killer, and, as the trial proceeds, makes an unlikely ally in Eddie Sanger (Dennis Quaid), a jury member. When they aren't in court, the two investigate the case and manage to uncover a massive conspiracy. (Movie, Thriller) - 1987-10-23

filmriseaction.us.description: A man steps out of a fountain in a park in Ho Chi Minh City with no memory of who he is. He wanders the city trying to piece together his past while being pursued by mysterious figures. (Action) - 2019

filmriseaction.us.title: Cover-Up
filmriseaction.us.description: An American journalist (Dolph Lundgren) gets too close to the truth about alleged terrorist attacks in Tel Aviv. (Action) - 1991

filmriseaction.us.title: Castle Falls
filmriseaction.us.description: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive. (Action, Thriller) - 2021

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Arlington Road
filmriseaction.us.description: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure) - 1999

filmriseaction.us.title: JCVD
filmriseaction.us.description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery. (Comedy, Crime drama, Action) - 2008

filmriseaction.us.title: Operator
filmriseaction.us.description: When the daughter of a dispatcher and a cop is kidnapped, they are forced to follow the kidnapper's rules and have to choose to save their daughter or the city. (Action, Drama, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E02 In Loco Louisa is up for promotion to head teacher, but Martin is on the board of governors and may go against her.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E04 Aromatherapy Martin must treat an elderly man with a horrible smell; a local radio host appears to have a drinking problem; Julie Mitchell arrives in Portwenn.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E05 Always on My Mind Martin is blamed when a patient dies during an examination; Joan urges Martin to explain the circumstances surrounding Helen's death to the widower.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E06 The Family Way Martin is surprised and puzzled when his parents suddenly arrive for a visit; Martin's examination of a woman leads to a surprise diagnosis.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E07 Out of the Woods Mark's stag night plans go awry when he is bitten by a snake, and rescue lies in the hand of Stewart, the park ranger.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E08 Erotomania Martin urges Mrs. Tishell to remove the collar she's worn for years; career disagreements lead Louisa to break up with Danny; a man from the Salvation Army arrives in Portwenn.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E01 The Apple Doesn't Fall A new police officer, who has narcolepsy, replaces Mark Mylow; Martin treats a girl who's been taking her mother's diet pills.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E02 Movement Unhappy with his lot in life, Bert Large abandons his plumbing business to start his own restaurant, but the eatery's opening is followed immediately by several cases of food poisoning.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E04 The Admirer Louisa Glasson finds out she has a rival for Doc Martin's affections; Martin accidentally runs over a dog.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E05 The Holly Bears a Prickle Louisa ends her relationship with Martin, but when she needs him to treat her injured friend, he gets a chance to redeem himself.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E06 Nowt So Queer Portwenn is buzzing with news; Bert's restaurant is in trouble, so his son decides to take action to save the business.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E07 Happily Ever After Martin needs to find a replacement vicar just three hours before the wedding; bridesmaid Isobel goes into labor.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E01 Better the Devil Martin prepares to leave Portwenn when his relationship with Louisa fails; Martin's medical school girlfriend arrives.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E02 Uneasy Lies the Head Martin is unsure what to do when he hears Louisa's news, but Louisa does not want him involved; Louisa's new headmaster is exhibiting erratic behavior.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E03 Perish Together as Fools Louisa has a medical scare and goes to Martin for reassurance; Joe Penhale's brother Sam comes to town; Martin learns the surgery needs some updating.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E04 Driving Mr. McLynn Martin urges Louisa to slow down after he catches her moving furniture; Martin refuses a handicapped parking tag for an elderly couple when the man won't prove he is disabled.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E05 The Departed The widow of one of Doc's patients believes her husband is trying to communicate from the grave; one of Louisa's students falls ill on a class trip.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E06 Midwife Crisis Doc clashes with the new district midwife over natural methods; Bert becomes enamored with a new restaurant employee.

filmriseclassictv.us.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
filmriseclassictv.us.description: This series follows the Clampett family from the Ozarks to posh Beverly Hills after they strike oil and become millionaires. Banker Mr. Drysdale tries to keep them from foolishly spending their newfound wealth, and he also tries to "civilize" them -- usually succeeding in making a fool of himself in the process. (Sitcom) - 1962-09-26

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Chef
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love. (Comedy drama) - 2014

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blitz
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2011

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Baby Gone
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Emily, who is pregnant, quickly becomes friends with her new, pregnant neighbor. Little does Emily know that Kelly has been faking her pregnancy so she can steal her baby. (Thriller) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Kill Switch
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tenn., by murdering young women, and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings. (Action, Thriller) - 2008

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Killing Season
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A U.S. veteran (Robert De Niro) and a former Serbian soldier (John Travolta) play cat-and-mouse games in the remote wilderness. (Thriller, Action) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The 51st State
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American. (Action, Comedy) - 2001

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Crime drama, Romance) - 2008

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gang of Roses
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew. (Western, Action) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

filmrisetruecrime.us.title: Meet, Marry, Murder
filmrisetruecrime.us.description: Though wedded couples vow to stay together until death do they part, a look at what happens when a groom or bride causes their beloved's death. (Crime, Documentary) - 2020-12-31

filmrisetruecrime.us.description: World's Most Evil Killers delves straight into the stories of the world's most prolific killers. retroplex.us.description: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture. retroplex.us.description: Brilliant medical student Michael (Oscar Isaac) meets beautiful dance instructor Ana (Charlotte Le Bon) in late 1914. Their shared Armenian heritage sparks an attraction that explodes into a romantic rivalry between Michael and Ana's boyfriend (Christian Bale), an American photojournalist who's dedicated to exposing the truth. As the Ottoman Empire crumbles into war-torn chaos, their conflicting passions must be deferred as they join forces to get themselves and their people to safety. (Historical drama, Romance) - 2016

retroplex.us.title: The Star Packer
retroplex.us.description: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Colorado Serenade
retroplex.us.description: One night, while out riding his horse, Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) comes upon a stagecoach being robbed by bandits. He intervenes and rescues the passengers, including a newly appointed judge, Roy Hilton (Forrest Taylor), who's traveling to the nearby town of Rawhide to bring law and order to the community. After witnessing Dean's heroics, the judge enlists the cowboy to help him, but their efforts are complicated by the arrival of mysterious drifter Nevada (David Sharpe). (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Tumbleweed Trail
retroplex.us.description: Scheming to steal Bill Ryan's (Kermit Maynard) cattle to pay a debt, his half-brother, Brad Barton (Bob Duncan), has his men shoot the rancher. With Bill left for dead, Brad and corrupt lawyer Alton Small (Ted Adams) produce a forged will that disinherits Bill's teenage daughter, Robin (Shirley Patterson), and son Freckles (Johnny McGovern). Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: West to Glory
retroplex.us.description: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), an undercover U.S. agent, is sent to a Mexican border town to protect the valuable Lopez diamond. One day he and his friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) attend a party thrown by Don Lopez (Harry Vejar), a wealthy prospector who also holds large reserves of gold. After Lopez insists that the mysterious Maria (Dolores Castle) wear the precious gem, Eddie becomes suspicious that she may be in league with the gang that recently stole some of Lopez's gold and killed one of his men. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Wild Country
retroplex.us.description: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Black Hills
retroplex.us.description: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Bells of Coronado
retroplex.us.description: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers. (Western) - 1950

retroplex.us.title: The Lucky Texan
retroplex.us.description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals. (Western) - 1934

classica.us.description: Mahlers 8. Symphonie, auch bekannt als die Symphonie der Tausend, ist ein monumentales Chor-Epos aus dem Jahr 1906, das ein riesiges Ensemble aus Solisten, Chören und einem gewaltigen Orchester erfordert. (Special) - 2026-03-28

classica.us.title: Berlioz : Symphonie fantastique, op. 14
classica.us.description: Das Armenische Nationalphilharmonische Orchester führt Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14 auf. Dieses ist unter der Leitung von Dirigent Eduard Topchjan. Komponiert wurde das Stück von Hector Berlioz im Jahr 1830. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-03-05

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi leitet das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester in einer Aufführung von Beethovens 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, Op. 55. Neben der fantastischen "Eroica" werden auch Strawinskis Psalmensinfonie und Strauss' "Don Juan" interpretiert. (Special, Entertainment, Music, Concert) - 2020-12-10

classica.us.title: Music in the Air
classica.us.description: Millionen Menschen sehen jedes Jahr die Live-Übertragung des Neujahrskonzerts. Als die Drei Tenöre anlässlich der Fußball-WM 1990 ihr legendäres Konzert in Rom gaben, sahen weltweit eine Milliarde Menschen an den Fernsehern zu. Die Dokumentation untersucht, welche Möglichkeiten das Fernsehen bietet, klassische Musik einem breiten Publikum näherzubringen. Was dachten Herbert von Karajan und Leonard Bernstein darüber, die als einige der ersten die Möglichkeiten dieses Mediums intensiv nutzten? (Documentary) - 2012

classica.us.title: Dvořák - Rusalka
classica.us.description: Der bulgarische Dirigent Pavel Baleff dirigiert das Orchester und den Chor der Opéra de Limoges in einer Aufführung von Antonín Dvořáks Rusalka. Das Libretto des Werkes stammt von dem tschechischen Dichter Jaroslav Kvapil. (Special, Music) - 2025-08-31

classica.us.title: Schumann - 2. Klaviersonate in g-Moll, op. 22
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz Schumanns Klaviersonate Nr. 2 in g-Moll, Op. 22. Es beginnt mit einem energischen ersten Satz, gefolgt von einem wunderschönen, langsamen Andantino nach Schumanns Lied "Im Herbste". (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-01-09

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Diabelli Variationen, Op. 120
classica.us.description: Daniel Barenboim spielt Beethovens letztes großes Klavierwerk, fertiggestellt im Jahre 1823. (Music) - 2020-05-05

classica.us.title: Werke für Violine und Klavier: Corelli, Ravel u.a
classica.us.description: Der japanische Geiger Naoya Nishimura und der italienische Pianist Andrea Bacchetti präsentieren ein intimes Recital, das in der Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan, aufgenommen wurde. Diese Aufführung wurde am 22. Juni 2019 aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-01-01

classica.us.title: Liszt - Elegien Nr. 1 und 2 (S. 130 & 131)
classica.us.description: Die italienische Cellistin Silvia Chiesa und der italienische Pianist Maurizio Baglini spielen Franz Liszts Zwei Elegien für Cello und Klavier. Diese Aufführung wurde am 4. November 2024 im Sala Verdi des Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi aufgenommen. (Special, Music) - 2025-10-04

classica.us.title: Die drei Leben der Clara Schumann
classica.us.description: Die Biografie von Clara Schumann ist legendenumwoben: Ihre strenge Kindheit, ihr außergewöhnliches Talent als Pianistin, ihre frühe Liebe zum Komponisten Robert Schumann und die Erziehung von sieben Kindern bieten Material für Mythen und Klischees. (Special, Documentary) - 2019-09-15

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise für zwei Klaviere Op. 77
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags spielt Martha Argerich Saint-Saëns Polonaise für Klavier Op. 77. Das Konzert wurde im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich, aufgezeichnet. Die Pianistin wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Special, Music) - 2025-06-01

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight

classica.us.title: Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin
classica.us.description: Für Freunde und Musiker war und ist die Schweizer Klaviervirtuosin Clara Haskil eine Interpretin, die wie keine andere Maßstäbe gesetzt hat. Anhand von Klaviereinspielungen, Briefen und Interviews zeigt der Film die Musikerin in neuem Licht. (Special, Documentary, Biography, Art) - 2017-08-27

classica.us.title: Rachmaninow - Sonate für Cello, Op. 19
classica.us.description: Silvia Chiesa und Maurizio Baglini präsentieren ein bezauberndes Konzert mit Werken von Busoni, Liszt, Chopin und Rachmaninow. Diese Aufführung wurde am 4. November 2024 im Sala Verdi des Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Mailand aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-10-04

classica.us.title: Heyward dirigiert Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 9
classica.us.description: Es ist eins der beliebtesten Stücke aller Zeiten: Mit der Aufführung von der 9. Sinfonie e-Moll unter dem Namen "Aus der Neuen Welt" von Antonín Dvořáks gibt der amerikanische Dirigent Jonathon Heyward mit dem "London Symphony Orchestra" sein Debüt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-10-04

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Streichquartette Nr. 3, 8 & 11
classica.us.description: Das französische Streichquartett Quatuor Ébène feiert den 250. Geburtstag von Ludwig van Beethoven mit der Aufnahme aller sechzehn Streichquartette des Komponisten, aufgeführt in sechs Konzerten in der Philharmonie de Paris im Herbst 2020. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-09-07

classica.us.title: Grieg, Klavierkonzert, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Artur Rubinstein und das London Symphony Orchestra unter der Leitung von André Previn spielen das Klavierkonzert a-Moll op. 16 von Edvard Grieg (1843-1907). Diese Aufnahme entstand im April 1975 in der Fairfield Hall Croydon. Auch im Alter von 88 Jahren schien Artur Rubinstein (1887-1982) nichts von der Lebenslust verloren zu haben, mit der er sein Publikum bereits seit fast einem Dreivierteljahrhundert begeistert hatte. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2012-12-17

classica.us.title: Bach - Matthäus-Passion, BWV 244

outlaw.us.title: The Sheepman
outlaw.us.description: Sheep farmer Jason Sweet (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small Western cattle town and promptly clashes with local tough guy Jumbo McCall (Mickey Shaughnessy). He also irks Stephen Bedford (Leslie Nielsen), a wealthy cattleman, with his advances toward Bedford's girlfriend, Dell Payton (Shirley MacLaine). With the entire town in an uproar over Sweet's behavior, Bedford arranges for Chocktaw Neal (Pernell Roberts), a seasoned gunslinger, to shoot him down. (Western, Comedy) - 1958

outlaw.us.title: Tall in the Saddle
outlaw.us.description: Cowboy Rocklin rides into a dusty western township where he's been promised work on a ranch. But when he finds that his future boss has been gunned down, he's forced to find work elsewhere. Despite his sexist attitudes, Rocklin charms the fiery Arly with his cavalier bravado and lands a job at her family's ranch. There, however, he learns that Judge Garvey was involved in his original employer's murder and is now trying to steal the dead man's land. (Western) - 1944

outlaw.us.title: Gunfight at Comanche Creek
outlaw.us.description: In 1875, a band of brutal bandits craft a dastardly scheme. First they bust a convicted man out of jail, and then they force him to commit a string of robberies to increase the price on his head. Finally, they murder him and collect the bounty. Lawman Bob Gifford (Audie Murphy) is onto their vicious plan, and he goes undercover as a prisoner to lure in these savage villains. But he struggles to stay focused after crossing paths with a sweet saloon owner (Colleen Miller). (Western) - 1963

outlaw.us.title: Chisum
outlaw.us.description: Kind-hearted, fatherly John Chisum (John Wayne) owns a large ranch in Lincoln County, New Mexico, in the 1870s. With the help of his faithful sidekick, Pepper (Ben Johnson), and a hot-headed young ranch hand nicknamed Billy the Kid (Geoffrey Deuel), Chisum does battle with underhanded land developer Lawrence Murphy (Forrest Tucker). Having bought up most of the nearby town and appointed his own corrupt sheriff (Bruce Cabot), Murphy now has his eye on Chisum's ranch. (Western) - 1970

outlaw.us.title: The Big Land
outlaw.us.description: Civil War veteran Chad Morgan (Alan Ladd) and alcoholic ex-architect Joe Jagger (Edmond O'Brien) are taken in by kindly Kansas farmer Sven (John Qualen) and his widowed daughter-in-law, Kate (Julie Bishop). To repay their kindness, Chad and Joe concoct a plan to create a market town for cattle and grain, with the help of Joe's sister, Helen (Virginia Mayo), and her railroad executive fiancé (Don Castle). But the violent boss of a nearby market (Anthony Caruso) will kill to keep his monopoly. (Western) - 1957

outlaw.us.title: The Command
outlaw.us.description: After Capt. Forsythe (Gregg Barton), the commanding officer of a cavalry troop, is killed in an attack, the new leader is Capt. Robert MacClaw (Guy Madison), a military doctor who has practically no field experience. With assistance from Sgt. Elliott (James Whitmore), MacClaw tries to lead his men to safety, using his ingenuity. But then they are ordered to guide a wagon train, containing the lovely Martha Cutting (Joan Weldon), among others, through dangerous American Indian territory. (Western) - 1954

outlaw.us.title: Bonanza - Blood on the Land
outlaw.us.description: Jeb Drummond is a murderous sheep herder who has Adam taken hostage to try and force Ben to sign over a large section of Ponderosa land to him. (Drama, Western) - 1960-02-13

outlaw.us.title: Hell on the Border
outlaw.us.description: A former slave becomes the first black deputy U.S. Marshal west of the Mississippi River in the late 1800s. (Western) - 2019

outlaw.us.title: Wild Stallion
outlaw.us.description: Raised by a cowboy (Edgar Buchanan) at a cavalry fort, an orphan becomes an officer (Ben Johnson) and looks for his long-lost horse. (Western) - 1952

outtvproud.us.title: Cadillac Man
outtvproud.us.description: Car dealer Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) is spread as thin financially as he is in his love life. He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage. (Comedy) - 1990

outtvproud.us.title: Cruel Intentions
outtvproud.us.description: Annette (Reese Witherspoon) unwittingly becomes a pawn in Sebastian's (Ryan Phillippe) and Kathryn's (Sarah Michelle Gellar) deliciously diabolical wager of sexual conquest when she writes an article in Seventeen Magazine about how she intends to stay pure until she marries her boyfriend. However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed. (Drama) - 1999

outtvproud.us.title: They Came Together
outtvproud.us.description: The owner (Amy Poehler) of an independent candy shop and the corporate stooge (Paul Rudd) who has been sent to shut her down begin an unlikely romance. (Romantic comedy) - 2014

outtvproud.us.title: Ginger Snaps
outtvproud.us.description: The story of two outcast sisters, Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins), in the mindless suburban town of Bailey Downs. On the night of Ginger's first period, she is savagely attacked by a wild creature. Ginger's wounds miraculously heal, but something is not quite right. Now Brigitte must save her sister and save herself. (Horror, Thriller) - 2000

outtvproud.us.title: Ginger Snaps II: Unleashed
outtvproud.us.description: A patient (Tatiana Maslany) at a rehabilitation center tries to prevent a young woman (Emily Perkins) from transforming into a werewolf. (Horror) - 2004

outtvproud.us.title: Ginger Snaps Back: The Beginning
outtvproud.us.description: In early 19th-century Canada, orphaned sisters Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins) find themselves lost in a forest while riding on horseback. They're rescued by The Hunter (Nathaniel Arcand), a mysterious Native American who takes them back to Fort Bailey. Something strange has happened there, however. The few settlers who remain are suspicious of outsiders and keep tight-lipped about the situation, but Ginger soon discovers their secret for herself. (Horror, Thriller) - 2004

outtvproud.us.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
outtvproud.us.description: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 1993

outtvproud.us.title: Repo! The Genetic Opera
outtvproud.us.description: In the mid-21st century, an epidemic of organ failures leads to the rise of GeneCo., a company providing transplants at a great price. Those who miss their payments become targets of GeneCo. Mercenaries, who repossess the organs. In a world of drug addiction and legalized murder, a sheltered youth seeks a cure for her rare disease as well as information about her family's mysterious history. Her questions are answered at "The Genetic Opera." (Horror, Musical) - 2008

outtvproud.us.title: From Prada to Nada
outtvproud.us.description: Spoiled sisters Nora (Camilla Belle) and Mary (Alexa Vega) Dominguez have a life of wealth and privilege in Beverly Hills. However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family. (Comedy, Romantic comedy, Action, Drama) - 2011

outtvproud.us.title: Lars and the Real Girl
outtvproud.us.description: Extremely shy Lars (Ryan Gosling) finds it impossible to make friends or socialize. His brother (Paul Schneider) and sister-in-law (Emily Mortimer) worry about him, so when he announces that he has a girlfriend he met on the Internet, they are overjoyed. But Lars' new lady is a life-size plastic woman. On the advice of a doctor (Patricia Clarkson), his family and the rest of the community go along with his delusion. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2007
