paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Farm to Table Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Mom's Retreat Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E10 Greenhouse Bliss Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E11 Multipurpose Cabana Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E12 Communal Gathering Space H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E02 Family of Five Funhouse Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E04 Stained Glass Studio Couple Farzana & Reyan have maxed out all living space in their city-sized bungalow, leaving no room for Reyan's at-home stained-glass business or Farzana's writing. Brian and Sarah build Reyan a spacious studio and construct an inspiring deck area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E05 Wellness Wonderland Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E07 Plunge Pool Paradise Aarati & Dave both work from home, forcing their living room to be a triple duty working/living/children's play area. Brian and Sarah create a flexible structure, install a sleek and sophisticated plunge pool, and create an outdoor fireplace lounge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E08 Pooch Party Pavillion Carly & Nate's social media star dog, Dean the Basset Hound, has a lot of four-legged friends visiting, leaving the home feeling cramped. Brian and Sarah make a bar/lounge for pet and owner gatherings, along with a stylish outdoor entertainment area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E09 Social Central Sunroom Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 The Bushland Treehouse Paul and Trent want to escape their busy lives to a 600-acre conservation property.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Forest Treehouse Delaval and Veronica are restoring 450 acres for conservation and funding it by building a treehouse in Swanton Novers Wood. A Scottish firm constructs it in 7 sections to minimize damage to the woodland habitat on delivery.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Countryside Cabins Jamie Feilden's 60-acre farm doubles as a charity for urban youth. To fund it, he now plans two prefabricated elliptical cabins on a remote slope. They'll feature timber decks, open-plan living, and green roofs—though weather may delay the build.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - How Washington DC Came to Be
truehistory.us.description: Uncovering the origins of the District of Columbia; how the location for the national government is chosen; the original design and vision for the city by artist and engineer Pierre Charles L'Enfant; the creation and history of the National Mall. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - The White House and the Presidency
truehistory.us.description: Tracking the history and fortunes of the White House; visiting the White House, beginning with the Oval Office and Cabinet Room; visiting the parks adjoining the White House; the Jefferson and Franklin Delano Roosevelt memorials. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - The Capitol Building and the Legislature
truehistory.us.description: How the Capitol building is designed, constructed and expanded in the early years of the nation; touring the architectural and artistic wonders of the building; concluding with the House and Senate Chambers; the surrounding parks and gardens. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - The Supreme Court and the Law of the Land
truehistory.us.description: Studying the founding and history of the Supreme Court; touring this structure, its interior features, court facilities and artistic decoration; exploring the Court in action, which encompasses courtroom procedure and how cases are processed. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - The Nation's Knowledge: Library of Congress
truehistory.us.description: Visiting the world's largest library; the story of the library's creation in the 18th century; beginning with the Jefferson Building; the facilities of the Adams and Madison buildings; visiting the Folger Shakespeare Library; the Eastern Market. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

truehistory.us.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City - Reflections On and of Pompeii
truehistory.us.description: When most people hear the name of the archeological site of Pompeii, they think of destruction; gaining an overview of the course; considering why the remains of Pompeii offer more than just a story of a cataclysm. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-09-03

truehistory.us.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City - Geology and Geography On the Bay of Naples
truehistory.us.description: Land and humankind help to shape Pompeii; examining the violent geological forces that forge the distinctive region of the Bay of Naples; tracing its influence on the surrounding geography; the various cultures that contribute to life in this area. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-09-03

truehistory.us.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City - The Rediscovery of Vesuvian Lands
truehistory.us.description: Archeological finds from the area are unearthed starting around 1594; uncovering the history of Pompeii's excavation in the 1700s, from the kings who plunder its artwork to the modern scholars who seek another kind of treasure. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-09-03

truehistory.us.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City - Etruscan Pompeii - 5th Century B.C.
truehistory.us.description: While the last days of Pompeii attract popular attention, the city is a thriving cultural center centuries before its destruction; delving deep into Pompeii's remote Etruscan history; exploring what life is like in this ancient pre-Roman settlement. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-09-03

truehistory.us.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City - Samnite Pompeii - 2nd Century B.C.
truehistory.us.description: Centuries after the establishment of Etruscan Pompeii, the city is invaded by the Samnites; witnessing the conquest of the city by these invaders; considering how Pompeii is redefined and expanded by its new inhabitants. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-09-03

truehistory.us.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City - Building the Roman Colony - 80 B.C.
truehistory.us.description: Encountering the first Roman inhabitants of Pompeii; learning how Pompeii becomes a Roman colony; taking a tour of the city as viewed through the eyes of two of its chief magistrates. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-09-03

truehistory.us.title: The World's Greatest Churches - The Earliest Churches
truehistory.us.description: Considering what defines a church; encompassing its religious uses and its functions as a place of assembly; how the first churches come into being; studying some of the best surviving basilica-type churches in Italy; their structural features. (Religious) - 2014-10-24

truehistory.us.title: The World's Greatest Churches - The Church of the Holy Sepulchre
truehistory.us.description: Tracing the history of this church in the Holy Land; the medieval reconstruction seen today; the church's unusual structure, which incorporates the "aedicule"; individual chapels reflecting events of the passion of Christ. (Religious) - 2014-10-24

truehistory.us.title: The World's Greatest Churches - Hagia Sophia
truehistory.us.description: Learning about the past of this jewel of Constantinople; discovering an extraordinary architectural space; highlighting its dome and interiors; lingering over its mosaics, carved columns and decoration in colored marbles. (Religious) - 2014-10-24

truehistory.us.title: The World's Greatest Churches - The Cave Churches of Cappadocia
truehistory.us.description: Pondering the unusual churches of Turkish Cappadocia, elaborately carved into the sides of mountains; the lives of the monks and hermits who live there; studying the churches' frescoes that illustrate biblical scenes and the life of Jesus. (Religious) - 2014-10-24

truehistory.us.title: The World's Greatest Churches - Great Churches of Russia
truehistory.us.description: The beauties of the churches of the Russian Orthodox tradition; the religious culture that inspires these structures; their characteristic gilded domes; their decoration of sculpture, frescoes and tile work; visiting outstanding cathedrals. (Religious) - 2014-10-24

rogerstvlondon.ca.title: Hiking With Kathleen
rogerstvlondon.ca.description: Join Kathleen as she combines her passions of photography and the outdoors in this series exploring campgrounds, wildlife and everything in between during road trips across Canada.

rogerstvlondon.ca.title: The London Food Bank at 40
rogerstvlondon.ca.description: Celebrating 40 years at the London Food Bank; Jane Roy and Glen Pearson sit down with London leaders to reflect on their pivotal roles in shaping the food bank's history.

rogerstvlondon.ca.title: Rogers tv Community News
rogerstvlondon.ca.description: A program dedicated to the community news happening in and around London and Middlesex.

rogerstvlondon.ca.title: Basketball North
rogerstvlondon.ca.description: Basketball North is your go-to source for all things basketball in London and Southern Ontario; we aim to showcase the homegrown athletes here in the City and Canadian basketball as a whole.

rogerstvlondon.ca.title: Recovery Toolbox
rogerstvlondon.ca.description: Beyond active addiction, life is about building, not just surviving. Recovery Toolbox with Dean Anderson provides real strategies and tools to transform recovery from a finish line into the foundation for the best quality of life.

rogerstvlondon.ca.title: Newsmakers
rogerstvlondon.ca.description: A look at the going ons in the City of London, Ontario.

rogerstvlondon.ca.title: The Energy Files w Forest & Flower
rogerstvlondon.ca.description: In The Energy Files, Heather of the Forest, a Nature-Based Wellness Center in Cambridge, and Stephanie of Stopping to Smell the Flowers, a Healing and Resource Centre in Thamesford, bring science and spirit together in an exploration of energy.

rogerstvlondon.ca.title: Cruisin' With Scott Bollert
